title: Days, months and time words
examples: Teacher, what day comes after Monday?
Can you show me what day is today?
If today is Wednesday, what day was before?

explain.say: Today we are learning about days of the week. There are seven days in one week. Can you say the days with me?

draw.text: Days of the week: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday

explain.say: The days go in a set order. After Sunday comes Monday. After Monday comes Tuesday. Can you say them in order for me?
We can talk about what comes before and what comes after. If today is Wednesday, what day was before Wednesday?
If today is Thursday, then tomorrow will be Friday. Tomorrow is the day right after today. Do you understand?

faq.q: How many days are in a week?
faq.a: There are seven days in one week. They are Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
asks: What is the length of a week?

faq.a: The day that comes after Saturday is Sunday. The week starts again on Sunday.
asks: What is the next day after Saturday?
After Saturday, what day is it?

faq.q: What does 'before' mean when talking about days?
faq.a: Before means the day that happened right before the day you are talking about. It is the day that came first.

faq.q: If today is Monday, what is tomorrow?
faq.a: If today is Monday, then tomorrow will be Tuesday. Tomorrow is always the next day in the sequence.

faq.q: Do we always start counting days from Sunday?
faq.a: In many places, the week is counted starting with Sunday. This helps us keep track of the days correctly.
asks: Does the week start on Sunday?

facts: There are seven days in one week.
The days of the week are Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
Tomorrow is the day that comes after today.
Yesterday is the day that came before today.

quiz.say: If today is Wednesday, what day was before today?
quiz.why: Tuesday comes right before Wednesday in the order of the week.

wrong.0: Monday is two days before Wednesday.
wrong.1: Thursday is the day after Wednesday.
wrong.2: Saturday is much later in the week.

quiz.say: If today is Friday, what is tomorrow?
quiz.why: Saturday is the day that follows Friday in the week.

wrong.1: Today is Friday, so tomorrow must be different.
wrong.2: Thursday is the day before Friday.
wrong.3: Sunday is too far ahead in the week.

quiz.why: The week cycles back to Sunday after Saturday.

wrong.1: Monday comes after Sunday, not after Saturday.
wrong.2: It cannot be the same day as the one before.
wrong.3: Friday is several days before Saturday.
